source: 牛津英语同义词学习词典 英汉双解版

abandon_0.zh: 这些词均表示离开、腾空。
abandon_0.en: These words all mean to go away from a building or place, leaving it empty.

leave_4.zh: 这些词均表示遗弃或抛弃某人。
leave_4.en: These words all mean to reject sb or to leave them without help or support.

stop_1.zh: 这些词均表示中断、停止。
stop_1.en: These words all mean to no longer continue to do sth or to make sb/sth no longer do sth.

deserted_0.zh: 这些词均表示废弃的、被舍弃的、被抛弃的。
deserted_0.en: These words all describe a place where there are no longer any people, or a person or thing that people have left behind.

church_0.zh: 这些词均表示宗教建筑。
church_0.en: These are all words for religious buildings.

short_2.zh: 这些词均表示简略的、缩写的、简洁的。
short_2.en: These words all describe sth that uses few words or letters, or fewer words than sth else.

give sth up_0.zh: 这些词均表示放弃、让与。
give sth up_0.en: These words all mean to let sb else have sth or to not do or demand sth.

stomach_0.zh: 这些词均表示腹部、肚子或腹部器官。
stomach_0.en: These are all words for the front part of the body below the chest and/or the organs inside this part of the body.

kidnap_0.zh: 这些词均表示劫持、绑架或捉拿。
kidnap_0.en: These words all mean to take sb away and keep them as a prisoner.

exception_0.zh: 这些词均表示异常事物、反常现象。
exception_0.en: These are all words for a person or thing that is different from what is considered normal or usual.

help_1.zh: 这些词均表示帮助、协助、援助。
help_1.en: These words all mean to make it easier or possible for sb to do sth by doing sth for them or by giving them sth that they need.

hate_0.en: These words all mean to have a strong feeling of dislike for sb/sth.

follow_2.zh: 这些词均表示接受、遵循、遵从。
follow_2.en: These words all mean to accept advice, instructions or rules and do what you have been told or shown to do.

ability_0.zh: 这些词均表示能力、才能。
ability_0.en: These are all words for the fact that sb is able to do sth, or the qualities necessary to do sth.

skill_0.zh: 这些词均表示技能、才能、才华。
skill_0.en: These are all words for sth that sb is able to do well.

excessive_0.zh: 这些词均表示行为过分的或数量过多的。
excessive_0.en: These words all describe sb's behaviour or an amount of sth that you think is more than is necessary, reasonable or appropriate.

good_3.zh: 这些词均表示精通的、擅长的。
good_3.en: These words all describe sb who does sth with skill.

abnormal_0.zh: 这些词均表示不正常的、反常的。
abnormal_0.en: These words all describe things or people that are different from what is usual or expected or considered normal by most people.

home_0.en: These words all mean a place where sb lives.

abolish_0.zh: 这些词均表示取消、终止。
abolish_0.en: These words all mean to change plans so that sth no longer happens.

disgusting_0.zh: 这些词均表示某事不堪的、令人震惊的。
disgusting_0.en: These words all describe sth that you think is unacceptable and shocking.

disgrace_0.zh: 这些词均表示恶人、恶事、恶行。
disgrace_0.en: These are all words for a bad or immoral person, thing or action.

apply_1.zh: 这些词均表示有关、涉及。
apply_1.en: These words all mean to be relevant to or connected with sb/sth, or to have sb/sth as a subject.

almost_0.zh: 这些词均表示几乎、差不多。
almost_0.en: These words are all used to mean to a great degree but not completely.

sharp_1.zh: 这些词均表示说话无礼的、简短生硬的。
sharp_1.en: These words all describe speaking in an unfriendly way and/or using few words.

sudden_0.zh: 这些词均表示突然的、急剧的、意外的。
sudden_0.en: These words all describe sth happening quickly or unexpectedly.

tumour_0.zh: 这些词均表示肿瘤、肿块、溃疡、疮。
tumour_0.en: These are all words for places on the skin or inside the body that are unhealthy and bigger than usual as a result of illness or injury.

lack_0.zh: 这些词均表示缺乏、匮乏、短缺。
lack_0.en: These are all words for talking about not having enough of sth or sth not being there.

careless_0.zh: 这些词均表示做事粗心的、健忘的。
careless_0.en: These words all describe people not giving enough attention and thought to what they are doing so that they forget things or make mistakes.

complete_0.zh: 这些词均表示完全的、彻底的、十足的。
complete_0.en: These words are all used to emphasize how great sth is in degree.

final_0.zh: 这些词均表示确定的、不可更改的。
final_0.en: These words all describe information or a decision that is certain and cannot be changed.

quite_1.zh: 这些词均表示完全、非常、彻底，或用以强调后接的词语。
quite_1.en: These words are all used to mean to the greatest possible degree or to emphasize the following word or phrase.

acquit_0.zh: 这些词均表示宣判无罪。
acquit_0.en: These words all mean to state that sb is not guilty of doing sth wrong or illegal.

interest_0.zh: 这些词均表示使感兴趣、使关注。
interest_0.en: These words all mean to catch and keep your attention.

use_2.zh: 这些词均表示消耗、耗费、耗尽。
use_2.en: These words all mean to take sth for a particular purpose so that there is less or none of it left.

withstand_0.zh: 这些词均表示承受住、抵住。
withstand_0.en: These words all mean to be strong enough not to be harmed or damaged by sth.

interested_0.zh: 这些词均形容人关注的、着迷的。
interested_0.en: These words all describe sb who is giving all their attention to sth.

interesting_0.zh: 这些词均表示有吸引力的、趣味十足的。
interesting_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that attracts or holds your attention because they are exciting, unusual or full of good ideas.

summary_0.zh: 这些词均表示总结、概要、摘要。
summary_0.en: These are all words for a short version of sth longer, especially a piece of writing or a discussion.

intellectual_0.zh: 这些词均表示思想的、理智的、观念上的。
intellectual_0.en: These words all describe things that are connected with ideas or the mind rather than the physical world.

idea_0.zh: 这些词均表示想法、概念、设想。
idea_0.en: These are all words for sth that you think or sth that comes into your mind.

ridiculous_0.zh: 这些词均表示荒谬的、荒唐的。
ridiculous_0.en: These words all describe sth that has no sense or reason.

exploit_0.zh: 这些词均表示利用、滥用。
exploit_0.en: These words all mean to treat sb/sth in a bad way, especially in order to gain an advantage for yourself.

offend_0.zh: 这些词均表示得罪、冒犯。
offend_0.en: These words all mean to upset sb because of sth that you say or do.

rape_0.en: These words all mean to attack sb sexually.

offensive_0.zh: 这些词均表示语言或人无礼的、冒犯的、惹人憎恶的。
offensive_0.en: These words all describe unpleasant or shocking language or people.

terrible_3.zh: 这些词均表示劣质的、劣等的、拙劣的。
terrible_3.en: These words all describe sth that is very bad or of a very low standard.

educational_0.zh: 这些词均表示教育的、有关教育的。
educational_0.en: These words all mean connected with education or providing education or information.

scholar_0.zh: 这些词均表示学者、知识分子、理论家。
scholar_0.en: These are all words for a person who is very intelligent or who thinks a lot about important matters.

school_0.en: These are all words for a place where people are taught or are trained in a skill.

accelerate_0.zh: 这些词均表示加速、加快。
accelerate_0.en: These words all mean to go faster or make sth happen faster.

voice_0.zh: 这些词均表示嗓音、发音、读音、说话声。
voice_0.en: These are all words for the way in which people say words or the sounds produced when they speak.

accept_0.zh: 这些词均表示困境无法改变时只得将就、面对或容忍。
accept_0.en: These words all mean to recognize that a difficult situation exists and cannot be changed, and that you must continue or deal with it.

agree_1.zh: 这些词均表示应允、答应。
agree_1.en: These words all mean to say that you will do what sb wants or that you will allow sth to happen.

get_1.zh: 这些词均表示收到、接到。
get_1.en: These words all mean to obtain sth by being given or sent it.

greet_0.zh: 这些词均表示欢迎、迎接。
greet_0.en: These words all mean to say 'hello' to sb when they arrive and/or to make them feel welcome somewhere.

let sb in_0.zh: 这些词均表示允许某人进入某处或加入某组织。
let sb in_0.en: These words all mean to allow sb to enter a place or join an organization.

take_4.zh: 这些词均表示接受提议、邀请或请求。
take_4.en: These words all mean to say 'yes' to an offer, invitation or request.

take_6.zh: 这些词均表示承担责任。
take_6.en: These words all mean to begin to have responsibility for sth.

adequate_0.zh: 这些词均表示还算好的、过得去的。
adequate_0.en: These words all describe sth that is good enough, but not very good.

fine_0.zh: 这些词均表示挺好的、不错的、可接受的。
fine_0.en: These words all describe sth that is good enough for you to accept.

right_2.zh: 这些词均表示符合道德或社会常理的、正当的。
right_2.en: These words all describe sth that is morally good or socially acceptable.

approval_0.zh: 这些词均表示许可、认可。
approval_0.en: These are all words for allowing sth to happen, usually because you think it is a good thing.

access_0.zh: 这些词均表示进入某地的途径或加入某团体的权利、机会。
access_0.en: These are all words for a way of entering a place or the right or opportunity to enter a place or join a group.

clear_2.zh: 这些词均表示语言文字清晰易懂的、明确无疑的。
clear_2.en: These words all describe speech or writing that is easy to understand and does not cause any confusion.

accomplice_0.zh: 这些词均表示帮凶、同谋。
accomplice_0.en: These are all words for a person who helps to commit a crime.

decoration_0.en: These are all words for sth that is added to sth to make it look more attractive.

accident_0.zh: 这些词均表示不测事件，尤指交通事故。
accident_0.en: These are all words for an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage.

luck_0.zh: 这些词均表示机遇、命运、运气。
luck_0.en: These are all words for things that happen or the force that causes them to happen.

praise_0.zh: 这些词均表示称赞、赞扬。
praise_0.en: These words all mean to express admiration or approval of sb/sth.

praise_1.zh: 这些词均表示赞赏、赞扬、赞美。
praise_1.en: These are all words for feelings or words that express admiration for sb's actions, achievements or appearance.

tribute_0.zh: 这些词均表示充满敬意的言辞或举动。
tribute_0.en: These are all words for sth that you say, write or do to show your respect or admiration for sb.

accommodate_0.zh: 这些词均表示提供住宿、膳宿、座位等。
accommodate_0.en: These words all mean to provide a place for sb to live, sleep or sit.

helpful_0.zh: 这些词均表示愿意帮忙的、乐于助人的。
helpful_0.en: These words all describe sb who is friendly and willing to help other people.

housing_0.en: These words all mean a place where you can live or stay.

accompany_0.zh: 这些词均表示陪同、跟随。
accompany_0.en: These words all mean to be with sb when they are doing sth, especially when they are going somewhere.

achieve_0.zh: 这些词均表示实现、达成。
achieve_0.en: These words all mean to succeed in doing sth or making sth happen.

work_2.zh: 这些词均表示工作成果。
work_2.en: These are all words for sth that is produced as a result of work.

contract_0.zh: 这些词均表示合同、合约、协议。
contract_0.en: These are all words for an official agreement between people, organizations or countries.

agreement_1.zh: 这些词均表示观点或感受一致。
agreement_1.en: These are all words for a situation in which people share opinions or feelings.

give_0.zh: 这些词均表示给予、授予。
give_0.en: These words all mean to allow sb to have sth.

bill_0.zh: 这些词均表示账单、账目。
bill_0.en: These are all words for a record of how much you owe for goods or services that you have bought or used.

fund_0.zh: 这些词均表示基金、专款、资金。
fund_0.en: These are all words for money that has been saved or is available for a particular purpose.

report_1.zh: 这些词均表示书面或口头的报道。
report_1.en: These are all words for a written or spoken description of events.

responsibility_0.zh: 这些词均表示责任、职责、义务，或对某事负责。
responsibility_0.en: These are all words for sth that you have to do, or the state of being responsible for sth.

explain_1.zh: 这些词均表示辩解、解释。
explain_1.en: These words all mean to support sb/sth that is being criticized or attacked or to give an explanation for sth.

official_1.zh: 这些词均表示公务的、公事的或获准的、官方认可的。
official_1.en: These words all describe things that are connected with sb in a position of authority or done with their permission.

build up_0.zh: 这些词均表示在数目或数量上逐渐增多。
build up_0.en: These words all mean to increase in number or amount over a period of time.

collect_0.zh: 这些词均表示收集、积累。
collect_0.en: These words all mean to get more of sth over a period of time, or to increase in quantity over a period of time.

exact_0.zh: 这些词均表示精确的、准确的。
exact_0.en: These words all describe sth that gives all the details of sth correctly.

charge_0.zh: 这些词均表示控告、指控、指责。
charge_0.en: These are all words for a claim that sb has done sth wrong or is guilty of sth.

accuse_0.zh: 这些词均表示控告或起诉。
accuse_0.en: These words all mean to say that sb has done sth wrong or committed a crime and must appear in court.

used to sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示习惯于、熟悉、了解。
used to sth_0.en: These words all mean knowing sth very well or knowing about sth.

revolution_1.zh: 这些词均表示彻底转变。
revolution_1.en: These are all words for a complete change of conditions, opinion, plan or behaviour.

hurt_0.zh: 这些词均表示身体某部位感到疼痛。
hurt_0.en: These are all words that can be used when part of your body feels painful.

pain_0.en: These are all words for the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

possible_0.zh: 这些词均表示能做到的、切实可行的。
possible_0.en: These words all describe things that can be done or achieved, or are worth trying because they are likely to be successful.

succeed_0.zh: 这些词均表示成功、成名，尤指在事业上或某领域中。
succeed_0.en: These words all mean to be or become successful, especially in your career or in a particular area of activity.

bitter_0.zh: 这些词均表示味道或气味强烈的、令人不适的。
bitter_0.en: These words all describe a strong, unpleasant taste or smell.

admit_0.zh: 这些词均表示承认，或不情愿地承认。
admit_0.en: These words all mean to agree, often unwillingly, that sth is true.

answer_1.zh: 这些词均表示答复、回答、回应。
answer_1.en: These words all mean to say, write or do sth as a reaction to a question or situation.

answer_0.zh: 这些词均表示答复、回答。
answer_0.en: These are all words for sth that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation.

friend_0.zh: 这些词均表示朋友、伙伴。
friend_0.en: These are all words for sb that you know well and enjoy spending time with.

friendship_0.zh: 这些词均表示友情、友谊、朋友关系。
friendship_0.en: These are all words for the feeling or state of being friends with sb.

meet_2.zh: 这些词均表示初次相识、结识。
meet_2.en: These words all mean to see and talk to sb for the first time.

buy_0.en: These words all mean to obtain sth by paying money for it.

get_0.zh: 这些词均表示得到、获得、获取。
get_0.en: These words all mean to do sth in order to make sure you have sth.

learn_0.zh: 这些词均表示学会知识或技能。
learn_0.en: These words all mean to gain knowledge or skill by studying, from experience or from being taught.

greedy_0.zh: 这些词均表示贪婪的、贪吃的、渴望的。
greedy_0.en: These words all describe people who want more money, power, food or possessions than they need.

bitter_1.zh: 这些词均表示因糟糕的经历而感到愤愤不平、闷闷不乐。
bitter_1.en: These words all describe people feeling angry and unhappy after a bad experience.

resentment_0.zh: 这些词均表示愤恨、怨恨、嫌隙。
resentment_0.en: These are all words for an angry feeling that exists between people after a bad experience.

overall_0.zh: 这些词均表示全面的、总括的、综合的。
overall_0.en: These words all describe sth which includes or covers all things or all of sth.

act_0.zh: 这些词均表示行动、采取措施。
act_0.en: These words all mean to deal with a situation in a particular way.

affect_0.zh: 这些词均表示对某人或某事物有影响。
affect_0.en: These words all mean to have an effect on sb/sth.

behave_0.zh: 这些词均表示以特定的方式行事。
behave_0.en: These words all mean to do things in a particular way.

play_3.zh: 这些词均表示演奏、演唱或扮演。
play_3.en: These words all mean to play a musical instrument, sing, act in a play, etc., especially to entertain an audience.

pretend_0.zh: 这些词均表示假装、伪装。
pretend_0.en: These words all mean to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe sth that is not true.

action_0.zh: 这些词均表示行为、行动。
action_0.en: These are all words for a thing that sb does.

performance_0.zh: 这些词均表示演出、表演。
performance_0.en: These are all words for an occasion on which a play, concert or some other form of entertainment is performed.

pretence_0.zh: 这些词均表示假装、伪装。
pretence_0.en: These are all words for the act of behaving in a particular way, in order to make other people believe sth that is not true.

rule_0.zh: 这些词均表示规则、规章、条例。
rule_0.en: These are all words for an official statement of what may, must or must not be done in a particular situation.

drama_0.zh: 这些词均表示表演艺术或专业。
drama_0.en: These words are all used to talk about the activity or profession of performing plays.

activity_0.zh: 这些词均表示热闹、活跃。
activity_0.en: These are all words for a situation in which a lot of things are being done.

case_0.zh: 这些词均表示官司、诉讼、审判。
case_0.en: These are all words for a formal legal dispute between people that is decided in court.

effect_0.zh: 这些词均表示效应、影响。
effect_0.en: These are all words for the changes in sb/sth that are caused by sb/sth else.

war_0.zh: 这些词均表示战争、战斗。
war_0.en: These are all words for a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other.

active_0.zh: 这些词均表示发挥功效或起作用。
active_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth being able to do, or doing, the activity or work that is typical for them.

disable_0.zh: 这些词均表示使人伤残或使事物不能运转。
disable_0.en: These words all mean to injure or damage sb/sth so that they cannot move or work.

busy_0.zh: 这些词均表示忙碌的、工作中的。
busy_0.en: These words all describe people doing a lot or having a lot to do.

energetic_0.zh: 这些词均表示精力充沛的、充满活力的或活动量大的。
energetic_0.en: These words all describe people or activities that have or show a lot of energy.

activist_0.zh: 这些词均表示做事或促使重大事情发生的人。
activist_0.en: These are all words for a person who does things or makes significant things happen.

project_0.zh: 这些词均表示为达到某一目的的活动、项目等。
project_0.en: These are all words for sth that you give your time and energy to, especially in order to achieve a particular aim.

actor_0.en: These are all words for a person whose job is to entertain an audience.

real_0.zh: 这些词均表示真实的、实际存在的、非凭空想象的。
real_0.en: These words all describe sth that is real and not imagined, false or artificial.

very_0.zh: 这些词均表示某个事物或时刻是特定的、正是的、恰好的。
very_0.en: These words are all used to emphasize that you are talking about a particular thing or moment.

serious_0.zh: 这些词均表示严重的、危急的。
serious_0.en: These words all describe things and situations that involve or cause harm or damage to sb/sth.

advertisement_0.zh: 这些词均表示广告或启事。
advertisement_0.en: These are all words for a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service.

change_2.en: These words all mean to make sb/sth different.

flexible_0.zh: 这些词均表示能适应新情况的、灵活的、可变动的。
flexible_0.en: These words all describe people or things that can change to suit new conditions or situations.

change_1.zh: 这些词均表示改变、调整、更正。
change_1.en: These are all words for the act or result of making sth different.

count_0.zh: 这些词均表示计算总数或总额。
count_0.en: These words all mean to calculate a total number or amount.

give_3.zh: 这些词均表示使人产生某种感觉或使东西具有某种特质。
give_3.en: These words all mean to produce a particular feeling in sb or a particular quality in sth.

fan_0.zh: 这些词均表示迷、爱好者、仰慕者。
fan_0.en: These are all words for a person who likes a particular thing, activity or person very much.

addictive_0.zh: 这些词均表示上瘾的、着迷的。
addictive_0.en: These words all describe behaviour that is difficult or impossible to stop or control.

call_0.zh: 这些动词均表示取名、命名。
call_0.en: These verbs all mean to give sb/sth a name or title.

focus_1.zh: 这些词均表示关注或针对特定的人或群体。

strange_1.zh: 这些词均表示陌生的、未知的。
strange_1.en: These words all describe people, places or things that you do not know or recognize.

divide_1.zh: 这些词均表示使人意见分歧或感情疏远。
divide_1.en: These words all mean to make people disagree or become emotionally distant from each other.

division_1.zh: 这些词均表示人与人之间的分歧或差异。
division_1.en: These are all words for disagreements or differences between people or groups of people.

get out_0.zh: 这些词均表示从交通工具上下来。
get out_0.en: These words all mean to leave a form of transport.

land_2.zh: 这些词均表示降落或着陆。
land_2.en: These are all words that can be used when sth comes down through the air and onto the ground or another surface.

arrange_0.zh: 这些词均表示排列、整理、安排。
arrange_0.en: These words all mean to put sth in a particular order, to make it look neat or to make it work efficiently.

like_1.zh: 这些词均表示与他人或他物类似、相似。
like_1.en: These words all describe sb/sth that is almost the same as sb/sth else.

alive_0.zh: 这些词均表示有生命的、活着的。
alive_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that has life.

safe_0.zh: 这些词均表示处境安全、未受伤害或损坏。
safe_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that is protected from danger or harm or is not harmed, damaged or injured.

in favour (of sb/sth)_0.zh: 这些动词和短语均表示赞成、同意、支持。
in favour (of sb/sth)_0.en: These verbs and phrases all mean to think that sth is good, acceptable or suitable.

ease_0.zh: 这些词均表示缓解、舒缓、减轻。
ease_0.en: These words all mean to become or make sth less unpleasant or severe.

claim_0.zh: 这些词均表示未经证实的说法。
claim_0.en: These are all words for a statement that sth is true, although it has not been proved.

supposed_0.zh: 这些词均表示假设的、推测的。
supposed_0.en: These words all describe people or things that are based on situations or ideas which are possible or imagined, not certainly true or real.

metaphor_0.zh: 这些词均表示修辞手法。
metaphor_0.en: These are all words for a word or phrase used in an imaginative way to describe sb/sth else.

road_0.zh: 这些词均表示路、道路、街道。
road_0.en: These are all words for a hard surface built for vehicles to travel on, often with houses and other buildings on both sides.

union_0.zh: 这些词均表示社团、工会、联盟、协会。
union_0.en: These are all words for groups of people, workers, political parties or other organizations who share an interest or purpose.

allocate_0.zh: 这些词均表示分配、划拨。
allocate_0.en: These words all mean to give sth officially to sb/sth for a particular purpose.

share_0.zh: 这些词均表示份额、定额、限额。
share_0.en: These are all words for an amount of sth which is given to sb/sth.

garden_1.zh: 这些词均表示花坛、果园、菜园。
garden_1.en: These are all words for a small piece of land where you can grow things such as flowers, fruit and vegetables.

untidy_0.zh: 这些词均表示不整齐的、凌乱的、杂乱的。
untidy_0.en: These words all describe places that are in a state of disorder, with things in the wrong places.

allow_0.zh: 这些词均表示允许、准许、批准。
allow_0.en: These words all mean to decide or say that sb may do sth or receive sth, or that sth may happen.

enable_0.zh: 这些词均表示使能够、使实现。
enable_0.en: These words all mean to make sth possible.

mixture_0.en: These are all words for a substance which consists of two or more other substances combined.

well_0.zh: 这些词均表示健康的、身体好的。
well_0.en: These words all describe sb who is not ill and is in good health.

mention_0.zh: 这些词均表示写到、提及或举例说明。
mention_0.en: These words all mean to write or speak about sb/sth, often in order to give an example or prove sth.

reference_0.zh: 这些词均表示提到、谈及。
reference_0.en: These are all words for sth that you say or write that mentions or repeats sb/sth else.

partner_0.zh: 这些词均表示搭档、同伴。
partner_0.en: These are all words for sb you work, study or do an activity with.

alone_0.zh: 这些词均表示单独、独自。
alone_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that is not with other people or things.

lonely_0.zh: 这些词均表示孤独的、寂寞的。
lonely_0.en: These words all describe a person who is unhappy because they have no friends or little contact with other people.

cold_1.zh: 这些词均表示冷漠的、不友好的。
cold_1.en: These words all describe a person or place that is not friendly or lacks feeling.

often_0.zh: 这些词均表示时常、常常、经常。
often_0.en: These words all describe things that are done or happen many times.

loser_0.zh: 这些词均表示比赛或选举中落败的人、输者。
loser_0.en: These are all words for sb who does not win or is not successful in a competition, race, game or election.

change_3.zh: 这些词均表示发生改变、起变化。
change_3.en: These words all mean to become different.

change_0.zh: 这些词均表示改变、变化，尤指多变。
change_0.en: These are all words for the act of becoming different, especially frequently.

surprise_0.zh: 这些词均表示使惊奇、使诧异。
surprise_0.en: These words all mean to make sb feel surprised.

amazing_0.zh: 这些词均表示令人惊奇的、令人惊叹的。
amazing_0.en: These words all describe things that are very surprising, often because they are greater than usual or normal.

spokesman_0.zh: 这些词均表示团体或机构的发言人、代表。
spokesman_0.en: These are all words for a person who speaks or acts on behalf of a group or organization.

misleading_0.zh: 这些词均表示误导的、引起误解的、欺骗性的。
misleading_0.en: These words all describe things that give the wrong idea or impression and make you believe sth that is not true.

ambition_0.zh: 这两个词均表示抱负、志向。
ambition_0.en: These are both words for the desire to be successful and to achieve things.

hope_1.zh: 这些词均表示愿望、心愿。
hope_1.en: These are all words for a wish to have or do sth.

unsure_0.zh: 这些词均表示无把握的、拿不准的、不确定的。
unsure_0.en: These words all describe sb who has feelings of doubt or uncertainty about sb/sth.

wander_0.zh: 这些词均表示漫游、闲逛。
wander_0.en: These words all mean to walk slowly around or to a place, often without having a clear purpose or direction.

passive_0.en: These words all describe sb who is easy to control or to influence.

facilities_0.zh: 这些词均表示供人使用的设施、设备。
facilities_0.en: These are all words for things which are provided in a place for people to use.

friendly_0.zh: 这些词均表示待人友善的、友好的、亲切的。
friendly_0.en: These words all describe sb who behaves in a kind and pleasant way to other people.

friendly_1.zh: 这些词均表示关系友善的、和睦的或气氛亲切友好的。
friendly_1.en: These words all describe a relationship or atmosphere that is pleasant and polite, not aggressive or full of arguments.

bullet_0.zh: 这些词均表示子弹、炮弹。
bullet_0.en: These are all words for an object that is fired from a gun.

corrupt_0.zh: 这些词均表示贪污的、腐败的、营私舞弊的。
corrupt_0.en: These words all describe people who are willing to do dishonest or illegal things for their own advantage.

number_0.zh: 这些词均表示数量、数额、数目，用于指有多少人或物。
number_0.en: These words are all used to refer to a group of people or things or a collection of sth, and to talk about how much/many there is/are.

hall_0.zh: 这些词均表示礼堂、大厅。
hall_0.en: These are all words for a large room that can hold a lot of people and is used for public and social events.

entertain_0.zh: 这两个词均表示娱乐、使快乐。
entertain_0.en: These words both mean to keep sb interested and happy by telling them things, performing for them or doing an activity with them.

entertainment_0.zh: 这些词均表示娱乐活动、消遣。
entertainment_0.en: These are all words for things or activities used to entertain people when they are not working.

interest_2.zh: 这些词均表示闲暇活动、业余爱好。
interest_2.en: These are all words for activities that you do for pleasure in your spare time.

funny_0.zh: 这些词均表示好笑的、滑稽的。
funny_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that makes you laugh or smile.

equivalent_1.zh: 这些词均表示对应的、等同的、匹配的。
equivalent_1.en: These words all describe things being equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.

comparison_0.zh: 这两个词均表示人或事物之间的比较、类比。
comparison_0.en: These are both words for the process of comparing two or more people or things.

examine_0.zh: 这些词均表示思量、调查、研究。
examine_0.en: These words all mean to think about, study or describe sb/sth carefully, especially in order to understand them, form an opinion of them or make a decision about them.

research_0.zh: 这些词均表示调查、研究或研究结果。
research_0.en: These are all words for the process of examining and finding out more about sth, or the result of this process.

analyst_0.zh: 这些词均表示分析员、评论家。
analyst_0.en: These are all words for a person who watches and considers events and situations, usually in order to give an opinion about them on television or radio or in a newspaper.

body_0.zh: 这些词均表示人或动物的躯体或体形。
body_0.en: These are all words for the physical structure or shape of a person or animal.

family_2.en: These are words for all the people who are related to each other, including those who are dead.

presenter_0.zh: 这些词均表示电视或广播节目主持人。
presenter_0.en: These are all words for a person who presents or talks on television or radio shows.

old_0.zh: 这些词均表示存在已久的、古老的。
old_0.en: These words all describe sth that has existed for a long time.

story_0.zh: 这些词均表示娱乐性的真实或虚构的故事。
story_0.en: These are all words for a description of real or imagined events intended to entertain people.

anger_1.zh: 这些动词均表示使人发怒。
anger_1.en: These verbs all mean to make sb angry or very angry.

anger_0.en: These are all words for the strong feelings you have when you are angry or very angry about sth.

angle_0.zh: 这些词均表示斜度、角度。
angle_0.en: These are all words for the position of sth that is not in a vertical or horizontal line.

attitude_0.zh: 这些词均表示态度、看法。
attitude_0.en: These are all words for the particular way you think or feel about sb/sth.

lean_0.zh: 这些词均表示倾斜、倾侧。
lean_0.en: These are all words that can be used when sb/sth moves or is moved so that they are/it is not straight or upright.

angry_0.zh: 这些词均表示生气的、发怒的。
angry_0.en: These words all describe people feeling and/or showing anger.

lose your temper_0.zh: 这些词语均表示生气、发怒、大发脾气。
lose your temper_0.en: These expressions all mean to become angry or very angry and show this in the way you talk or behave.

upset_0.zh: 这些词均表示难过的、震惊的、失望的。
upset_0.en: These words all describe sb who is unhappy, shocked or disappointed because sth unpleasant has happened.

animal_0.zh: 这些词均表示动物、生物。
animal_0.en: These are all words for sth which is alive but which is not a human or a plant.

lively_0.zh: 这些词均表示精力充沛的、生气勃勃的。
lively_0.en: These words all describe sb who is full of energy.

invade_0.zh: 这些词均表示用武力侵占、夺取、攻占。
invade_0.en: These words all mean to take control of a place using military force.

destroy_0.zh: 这些词均表示摧毁、除掉或杀死。
destroy_0.en: These words all mean to damage, remove or kill sb/sth so that they no longer exist.

birthday_0.en: These are all words for a time when you remember sth that happened a year or a number of years ago.

declare_0.zh: 这些词均表示公开、坚定、明确地宣布某事。
declare_0.en: These words all mean to say sth, usually firmly and clearly and often in public.

statement_0.zh: 这些词均表示声明、公告或评论。
statement_0.en: These are all words for sth that you say or write, especially sth that gives information or an opinion.

annoy_0.zh: 这些词均表示让人不快或不耐烦。
annoy_0.en: These words all mean to make sb slightly angry or impatient.

frustration_0.zh: 这些词均表示懊恼、烦恼、微怒。
frustration_0.en: These are all words for the feeling of being slightly angry.

annoyed_0.zh: 这些词均表示烦恼的、不快的。
annoyed_0.en: These words all describe sb feeling slightly angry about sth.

annoying_0.zh: 这些词均表示让人烦恼的、令人恼怒的。
annoying_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that makes you feel angry or annoyed.

cancel_0.zh: 这些词均表示正式废除某项法律、协议，或宣告某文件、政策失效。
cancel_0.en: These words all mean to officially end a law or agreement or to say that a document or policy is no longer valid.

coat_0.zh: 这些词均表示外套、外衣、礼服。
coat_0.en: These are all words for a piece of clothing that you wear over other clothes to keep you warm and dry outdoors or to look smart on formal occasions.

solution_0.zh: 这些词均表示解决方法、处理手段、答案。
solution_0.en: These are all words for a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.

anticipate_0.zh: 这些词均表示预先阻止、预先做准备或抢先做某事。
anticipate_0.en: These words all mean to prevent or prepare for sth that you think will happen in the future, or to do sth before sb else does it.

expect_0.zh: 这些词均表示预计、期待。
expect_0.en: These words all mean to believe that sth will happen or to wait for it to happen.

expectation_0.zh: 这些词均表示预言、预测或预见力。
expectation_0.en: These are all words for a statement or belief about what will happen in the future, or the ability to make such a statement.

disappointment_0.zh: 这些词均表示令人失望的事情。
disappointment_0.en: These are all words for sth that is disappointing.

drug_1.zh: 这些词均表示药物或治疗。
drug_1.en: These are all words for treatments for people who are ill.

old-fashioned_0.zh: 这些词均表示过时的、不时髦的、守旧的。
old-fashioned_0.en: These words all describe sth which is not modern or fashionable, or sb who does not have modern or fashionable ideas.

solitary_0.zh: 这些词均表示喜欢独处的、内向的。
solitary_0.en: These words all describe a person who prefers to spend time alone rather than with other people.

opposite_0.zh: 这些词均表示对立的人或物、对立面、反面。
opposite_0.en: These are all words for a person or thing that is as different as possible from sb/sth else.

eager_0.zh: 这些词均表示热切的、渴望的、充满期待的。
eager_0.en: These words all describe people who want to do sth, or want sth to happen, very much.

stressful_0.zh: 这些词均表示情况、事件或时期等紧张的、令人焦虑的。
stressful_0.en: These words all describe situations, events or times that cause worry and anxiety.

worried_0.zh: 这些词均表示担心的、担忧的。
worried_0.en: These words all describe feeling unhappy and afraid because you are thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or might have happened.

fail_1.zh: 这些词均表示失败，尤指劳而无功。
fail_1.en: These words all mean to be unsuccessful, especially after a period of time trying to do sth.

flat_0.zh: 这些词均表示一套房间、公寓套房。
flat_0.en: These are all words for a set of rooms for living in.

indifferent_0.zh: 这些词均表示不感兴趣的、反应冷淡的。
indifferent_0.en: These words all describe a person or their behaviour when they show no interest or enthusiasm.

hole_0.zh: 这些词均表示裂口、开口。
hole_0.en: These words are all used for an open space in sth or between things, that sth can pass through or where sth is missing.

confidence_0.zh: 这些词均表示自信、自信心。
confidence_0.en: These are all words for a belief in yourself and your abilities.

apologize_0.en: These words all mean to say sorry for sth.

shock_1.zh: 这些词均表示使人震惊且不快。
shock_1.en: These words all mean to surprise and upset sb very much.

terrible_2.zh: 这些词均表示令人震惊的、骇人听闻的，或造成极大伤害的。
terrible_2.en: These words all describe sth that is extremely shocking or frightening, or that causes great harm.

equipment_0.zh: 这些词均表示设备、器材。
equipment_0.en: These are all words for the things that you need for a particular purpose or activity.

system_0.zh: 这些词均表示系统、体系、体制。
system_0.en: These are all words for the way sth is organized or the way the different parts of sth connect with each other.

clothes_0.zh: 这些词均表示衣服、服装。
clothes_0.en: These are all words for the things that you wear, such as shirts, jackets, dresses and trousers.

apparent_0.zh: 这些词均表示貌似但未必真实的。
apparent_0.en: These words all describe things that appear to be real or true but may not be.

clear_1.zh: 这些词均表示清楚明白的、显而易见的、清晰易懂的。
clear_1.en: These words all describe a fact, quality or situation that is easy to see or understand and leaves no doubts.

ghost_0.zh: 这些词均表示鬼、鬼魂、幽灵，尤指活人相信可以看到或听到的。
ghost_0.en: These are all words for an image of a person who is dead, especially one that a living person believes they can see or hear.

interest_1.zh: 这些词均表示吸引力、魅力、魔力。
interest_1.en: These are all words for a feature or quality that makes sth seem attractive, interesting or exciting to people.

request_0.zh: 这些词均表示正式的要求、请求。
request_0.en: These are all words for the action of asking for sth formally and/or politely.

ask_1.zh: 这些词均表示要求、请求。
ask_1.en: These words all mean to tell sb that you would like them to do sth or give you sth, or that you would like sth to happen.

court_0.zh: 这些词均表示法院、法庭。
court_0.en: These are all words for a place where trials and other legal cases are held and judged.

popular_0.zh: 这些词均表示受喜爱的、受欢迎的。
popular_0.en: These words all describe people or things that are liked or wanted by a large number of people.

appear_0.zh: 这些词均表示出现、呈现或显现。
appear_0.en: These words all mean to start to be seen in a place.

arrive_0.zh: 这些词均表示到达、抵达。
arrive_0.en: These words all mean to get to a place.

feature_1.zh: 这些词均表示起重要作用、是重要组成部分。
feature_1.en: These words all mean to have an important part in sth, or to include sb/sth as an important part.

seem_0.zh: 这些词均表示好像、似乎。
seem_0.en: These words all mean to give the impression of being or doing sth.

calm_0.zh: 这些动词均表示使安静、安抚、宽慰。
calm_0.en: These verbs all mean to make sb feel more relaxed and less anxious, excited, angry or upset.

appetite_0.zh: 这些词均表示食欲、胃口。
appetite_0.en: These are all words for the desire to eat food.

appetite_1.zh: 这些词均表示强烈欲望。
appetite_1.en: These are all words for a strong desire for sth.

delicious_0.zh: 这些词均表示食物或饮料美味可口的。
delicious_0.en: These words all describe food or drink that tastes nice.

machine_0.en: These are all words for a piece of equipment with moving parts that is designed to do a particular job.

relevant_0.zh: 这些词均表示紧密相关的、切题的、适宜的。
relevant_0.en: These words all describe sth that relates directly to what you are discussing or thinking about, or sth that is directly appropriate to people's lives and work.

candidate_0.zh: 这些词均表示申请者、候选人、参加者。
candidate_0.en: These are all words for sb who is applying for sth such as a job or position.

use_0.zh: 这些词均表示使用、实践、运用。
use_0.en: These are all words for the act of using sth or doing sth.

practical_0.zh: 这些词均表示实际的、真实的。
practical_0.en: These words all describe things that are connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories.

apply_0.zh: 这些词均表示实施、运用。
apply_0.en: These words all mean to cause sth such as a law, or knowledge or skills to be used.

appoint_0.zh: 这些动词均表示任命或委任要职。
appoint_0.en: These verbs all mean to officially or formally choose sb for a job, especially an important one, or for a position of responsibility.

job_0.zh: 这些词均表示职位或职位空缺。
job_0.en: These are all words for a position doing work for which you receive regular payment.

meeting_1.zh: 这些词均表示会面、约会、见面。
meeting_1.en: These are all words for an occasion when two or more people meet.

assessment_0.zh: 这些词均表示评价、评定，尤指书面评论。
assessment_0.en: These are all words for an opinion or judgement of sb/sth, especially in a piece of writing.

know_0.zh: 这些词均表示理解或意识到某事。
know_0.en: These words all mean to understand or be aware of sth.

welcome_0.zh: 这两个词均表示乐意接纳、欣然接受。
welcome_0.en: These words both mean to be pleased to receive or accept sth.

thanks_0.zh: 这些词均表示感谢、感激。
thanks_0.en: These are all words for words, actions or feelings that show how grateful you are for sth.

understanding_0.zh: 这些词均表示理解力、洞察力、领悟力。
understanding_0.en: These are all words for sb's ability to understand situations, subjects, etc.

grateful_0.zh: 这些词均表示感激的、感恩的。
grateful_0.en: These words all describe people feeling or showing thanks because sb has done sth kind for them or has done as they asked.

arrest_0.zh: 这些词均表示逮住某人。
arrest_0.en: These words all mean to stop sb and prevent them from escaping.

recruit_0.zh: 这些词均表示新入职者、新加入者。
recruit_0.en: These are all words for a person who has just started a job or activity and has very little experience.

remember_0.zh: 这些词均表示记住、回想起。

start_1.zh: 这些词均表示开始发生、开始做。

beginner_0.zh: 这些词均表示新手、初学者。

source_0.zh: 这些词均表示来源、起源、起因。

start_0.zh: 这些词均表示开端、开头部分或初期阶段。

laugh_0.zh: 这些词均表示出声地笑。

faith_0.zh: 这些词均表示信任、相信、信心。

view_0.zh: 这些词均表示看法、意见、观点。

criterion_0.zh: 这些词均表示用来评判的标准、准则、尺度。

tendency_0.zh: 这些词均表示倾向、偏好、性情。

determined_0.zh: 这些词均表示下定决心、坚定不移。

compare_1.zh: 这些词均表示相匹敌、不相上下。

burn_0.zh: 这些词均表示燃烧、着火。

stand_0.zh: 这些词均表示站立、起立。

legacy_0.zh: 这些词均表示遗产或遗赠的财物。

scold_0.zh: 这些词均表示批评、训斥、责备。

favourite_0.zh: 这些词均表示特别受喜爱的。

know_1.zh: 这些词均表示确信、肯定。

improve_1.zh: 这些词均表示改善、好转。

recover_0.zh: 这些词均表示康复、痊愈。

example_0.zh: 这些词均表示实例、例证。

investigation_0.zh: 这些词均表示调查、查究，尤指详尽的调查。

patient_0.zh: 这些词均表示病人、患者。

cover_0.zh: 这些词均表示覆盖物、包裹物、套子。

explain_0.zh: 这些词均表示解释、说明。

look_2.zh: 这些词均表示寻找、寻求、寻觅。

series_0.zh: 这些词均表示一连串同类的事件、事物或人。

see_0.zh: 这些词均表示看到、注意到。

slogan_0.zh: 这些词均表示口号、格言。

fame_0.zh: 这些词均表示名声、名望、出名。

professor_0.zh: 这些词均表示大学教授、学校校长。

turn_1.zh: 这些词均表示外观或性质发生改变，或使之改变。

wear_0.zh: 这些词均表示穿着、穿上。

switch_0.zh: 这些词均表示改变、转变。

channel_0.zh: 这些词均表示电视台或电台、电视或广播节目、频道或波段等。

ditch_0.zh: 这些词均表示用来排水的沟渠。

sing_0.zh: 这些词均表示唱歌、哼曲。

chaos_0.zh: 这些词均表示混乱无序。

character_0.zh: 这些词均表示故事中的人物、角色。

charm_0.zh: 这些词均表示魅力、吸引力。

nature_0.zh: 这些词均表示基本特征、本质。

number_1.zh: 这些词均表示符号、代号、记号。

person_0.en: These are all words for a man, woman or child.

personality_0.zh: 这些词均表示性格、个性。

reputation_0.zh: 这些词均表示名声、名誉、形象。

mercy_0.zh: 这些词均表示仁慈、宽恕。

record_1.zh: 这些词均表示记录、记载、录入。

rude_0.zh: 这些词均表示粗鲁的、无礼的。

encourage_0.zh: 这些词均表示鼓励、激励。

fragment_0.zh: 这些词均表示碎片、碎屑。

citizen_0.zh: 这些词均表示公民、国民。

social_0.en: These words all describe things connected with society and ordinary people.

national_0.zh: 这些词均表示国家的、本国的、国内的。
national_0.en: These all describe things connected with a particular country rather than foreign countries.

polite_0.zh: 这些词均表示有礼貌的、恭敬的。
polite_0.en: These words all describe sb who behaves in a way that shows good manners and respect.

respect_1.zh: 这些词均表示礼貌、礼节。
respect_1.en: These are all words for behaviour that is considered to be polite or correct.

culture_0.zh: 这些词均表示人类群体。
culture_0.en: These are all words for groups of people who share the same customs, beliefs and way of life.

people_1.zh: 这些词均表示人民、国民或种族、民族。
people_1.en: These are all words for a group of people from the same place, or belonging to the same nation, race or culture.

secret_1.zh: 这些词均表示行动或行为是暗中进行的、隐秘的。
secret_1.en: These words all describe actions or behaviour which other people do not know about.

pat_0.en: These words all mean to hit a person or animal lightly, with your open hand or your fingers.

conflict_0.zh: 这些词均表示抵触、矛盾、不一致。
conflict_0.en: These are all words for a situation in which two things are very different from each other and cannot easily exist together.

confrontation_0.zh: 这些词均表示对抗、对峙、冲突。
confrontation_0.en: These are all words for an unfriendly disagreement between two people or groups of people.

hold_0.zh: 这些词均表示抓住、抱住。
hold_0.en: These words all mean to have sb/sth in your hands or arms.

class_0.en: These are all words for a series of subjects or skills that are taught or studied for the purposes of education or training.

class_1.zh: 这些词均表示用来学习的一段时间、一节课。
class_1.en: These are all words for a period of time that is spent learning sth.

class_2.zh: 这些词均表示班级、年级、小组。
class_2.en: These are all words for groups in which students are taught together.

class_3.zh: 这些词均表示阶级、等级、地位。
class_3.en: These are all words for a group in society or within an organization that sb belongs to, based on how much importance or authority they have, or for a measure of how good or important sb/sth is compared with sb/sth else.

style_0.zh: 这些词均表示优雅、品味、魅力。
style_0.en: These are all words for the quality of being pleasing to look at and/or doing things in an attractive and imaginative way.

elegant_0.zh: 这些词均表示优美的、高雅的。
elegant_0.en: These words all describe the look of people and things that are attractive and have a good style.

excellent_0.zh: 这些词均表示优秀的、杰出的。
excellent_0.en: These words all describe sth that is extremely good.

traditional_0.zh: 这些词均表示传统的、因袭的、正统的。
traditional_0.en: These words all describe things or ideas that are based on what has happened or been accepted in the past.

secret_0.zh: 这些词均表示信息是秘密的、保密的、私人的。
secret_0.en: These words all describe information which is not known about by other people or not meant to be known about.

fashionable_0.zh: 这些词均表示时兴的、时髦的。
fashionable_0.en: These words all describe things that many people admire or want at a particular time.

scratch_1.zh: 这两个词均表示用爪子或指甲搔、挠、抓。
scratch_1.en: These words both mean to rub or tear sth with claws or nails.

soil_0.zh: 这些词均表示土壤、泥土、土地。
soil_0.en: These are all words for the top layer of the earth in which plants grow.

clean_1.zh: 这些词均表示干净的、卫生的。
clean_1.en: These words all describe sth which is not dirty.

tidy_0.zh: 这些词均表示整理、打扫、清除干净。
tidy_0.en: These words all mean to make sth look neat by putting things where they belong and removing rubbish or dirt.

clear_3.zh: 这些词均表示透明的、清澈的。
clear_3.en: These words all describe sth which you can see through.

sunny_0.zh: 这些词均表示天气好的、晴朗的。
sunny_0.en: These words all describe good weather.

clear_0.zh: 这些词均表示清走、清空或取出、卸下。
clear_0.en: These words all mean to remove things from somewhere or take things out of sth.

disappear_0.zh: 这些词均表示消失、消逝、绝迹。
disappear_0.en: These words all mean to stop existing or being in a place.

pay_0.zh: 这些词均表示付清欠款、结账。
pay_0.en: These words all mean to pay the money that you owe.

solve_1.zh: 这些词均表示解答、破解。
solve_1.en: These words all mean to find the correct answer or explanation for sth.

tighten_0.zh: 这些词均表示使变紧、使更加牢固。
tighten_0.en: These words all mean to make sth become tight or tighter.

tired_1.zh: 这些词均表示事物，尤其是语言了无新意的、陈腐的、陈词滥调的。
tired_1.en: These words all describe things, especially language, that are uninteresting because they have been used too much.

weather_0.zh: 这些词均表示天气、气象。
weather_0.en: These are all words for the conditions of the atmosphere.

peak_0.zh: 这些词均表示顶峰、高峰。
peak_0.en: These are all words for the point when sb/sth is best, most successful, strongest, or at their highest level.

rise_0.zh: 这些词均表示数量、水平或数值增加、上升。
rise_0.en: These are all words that can be used when the amount, level or number of sth gets bigger or higher.

slope_1.zh: 这些词均表示倾斜、有坡度。
slope_1.en: These are all words that can be used when land or a surface leads downwards or upwards.

confirm_2.zh: 这些词均表示使更加相信、使确信或最终确定。
confirm_2.en: These words all mean to make sb feel or believe sth even more strongly, or make a final decision about sth.

hospital_0.zh: 这些词均表示医疗机构。
hospital_0.en: These are all words for a place where people can get medical treatment.

surgery_0.zh: 这些词均表示诊室、诊所或医疗中心。
surgery_0.en: These words all mean a place where you can see a doctor for advice and treatment.

scene_0.zh: 这些词均表示书、电影或音乐等的片段。
scene_0.en: These are all words for a short section of a work, such as a book, film or piece of music.

cut_2.zh: 这些词均表示剪短或修剪。
cut_2.en: These words all mean to make sth shorter or neater by removing part of it with a sharp tool.

courtyard_0.zh: 这些词均表示墙或建筑物所围成的庭院、院子、天井。
courtyard_0.en: These words all mean an open space that is surrounded by a wall or buildings.

end_1.zh: 这些词均表示结束、终止。
end_1.en: These words all mean to come to an end or to bring sth to an end.

close_0.zh: 这些词均表示比赛或竞赛实力接近的、势均力敌的，或情况几乎出现或没有出现。
close_0.en: These words all describe a race or contest in which two people or teams are equal, or a situation in which sth nearly happens or does not happen.

last_0.zh: 这些词均表示最后的、末尾的。
last_0.en: These words all describe sth that happens or comes after all other similar things or people.

fabric_0.zh: 这些词均表示织物、布料。
fabric_0.en: These are all words for woven or knitted cotton, silk, wool, etc., used for making things such as clothes and curtains, and for covering furniture.

cloud_0.en: These are all words for a mass of very small drops of water in the air.

cloud_1.zh: 这些词均表示烟尘等的一团、一片。
cloud_1.en: These are all words for a large mass of dust or smoke in the air.

darken_0.zh: 这些词均表示变暗、变黑或使变暗、变黑。
darken_0.en: These words all mean to become or make sth become dark or darker.

cloudy_0.zh: 这些词均表示天气多云、阴天。
cloudy_0.en: These words all describe the weather when there are lots of clouds in the sky.

team_1.en: These are all words for a group of people who play a sport together against other groups.

suggestion_0.zh: 这些词均表示线索、迹象。
suggestion_0.en: These are all words for a piece of information, often given indirectly, that helps you find sth out.

ignorant_0.zh: 这些词均形容人无知的、未受过教育的。
ignorant_0.en: These words all describe sb who lacks knowledge about sth or is not educated.

crowd_1.zh: 这些词均表示人群聚集或拥向某处。
crowd_1.en: These words are all used to talk about people standing or moving together in a group.

mess_0.zh: 这些词均表示杂乱、混乱、乱七八糟。
mess_0.en: These are all words you can use when a place or group of things is very untidy.

coach_0.zh: 这些词均表示教练、训练员、导师。
coach_0.en: These are all words for a person who trains a team or person in a practical skill or a sport.

train_0.zh: 这些词均表示训练、培训、教导。
train_0.en: These words all mean to teach sb/yourself or an animal the skills for a particular job or activity.

education_0.zh: 这些词均表示教育、培训。
education_0.en: These are all words for the process of learning or being taught.

oil_0.en: These are all words for substances that provide heat or light energy when they are burnt.

pressure_0.zh: 这些词均表示强迫、胁迫。
pressure_0.en: These are all words for the act of trying to make sb do sth, sometimes using threats or violence.

convincing_0.zh: 这些词均表示论据、观点或证据令人信服的、有说服力的。
convincing_0.en: These words all describe an argument, opinion or evidence that is expressed firmly and clearly so that sb believes it is true.

efficiency_0.zh: 这些词均表示条理、效率。
efficiency_0.en: These are all words for the quality of being organized and working well.

rational_0.zh: 这些词均表示行为或思维方式合理的、理性的、明智的。
rational_0.en: These words all describe behaviour or a way of thinking that is based on reason, facts and clear, careful thought.

wrap sb/sth around/round sb/sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示盘绕、缠绕。
wrap sb/sth around/round sb/sth_0.en: These words all refer to sth turning around itself or being put around sth else.

invent_0.zh: 这些词均表示编造、捏造、虚构或创造新词语或名称。
invent_0.en: These words all mean to say or describe sth that is not true or to use a new word, phrase or name.

traitor_0.zh: 这些词均表示背叛者、变节者、叛徒。
traitor_0.en: These are all words for a person who betrays their friends, their country or another group or organization to which they are supposed to be loyal.

collapse_1.zh: 这些词均表示因生病、疲惫或震惊而晕倒、昏倒。
collapse_1.en: These words all mean to fall down and/or become unconscious because you are very ill or tired or have had a shock.

get_2.zh: 这些词均表示到某地去接人或取东西。
get_2.en: These words all mean to go to a place where sb/sth is and bring them/it back.

raise_0.zh: 这两个词均表示为特定目的募捐、募集。
raise_0.en: These words both mean to ask people to give you money for a particular purpose.

common_0.zh: 这些词均表示共有的、共享的、公共的。
common_0.en: These words all describe sth that is shared by or involves a number of people.

plot_0.zh: 这些词均表示密谋非法或害人的事。
plot_0.en: These words all mean to secretly plan to do sth illegal or harmful.

conspiracy_0.zh: 这些词均表示阴谋、密谋、诡计。
conspiracy_0.en: These are all words for a secret plan to do sth illegal or harmful, or to deceive sb.

territory_0.zh: 这些词均表示殖民地、托管地、属地。
territory_0.en: These are all words for a country or area that is occupied or controlled by another country.

colour_1.zh: 这些词均表示植物表面的颜色，动物或人的肤色。
colour_1.en: These are all words for the colour in the appearance of plants, animals or people.

huge_0.zh: 这些词均表示巨大的、庞大的。
huge_0.en: These words all describe sth which is extremely large.

colour_0.zh: 这些词均表示颜色、色彩。
colour_0.en: These words all describe the appearance of things, resulting from the way in which they reflect light.

draw_1.en: These words all mean to make a picture of sb/sth.

paint_0.zh: 这些词均表示涂上或染上颜色。
paint_0.en: These words all mean to add colour to sth or change the colour of sth with a substance.

coloured_0.zh: 这些词均表示颜色鲜艳的、五彩缤纷的。
coloured_0.en: These words all describe things that are a bright colour or that have a lot of different colours.

drab_0.zh: 这些词均表示平淡无奇的、无趣的。
drab_0.en: These words all describe things or people that are not interesting or unusual so that you do not notice or remember them.

row_0.zh: 这些词均表示一排、一列、一行。
row_0.en: These are all words for a number of people or things all standing next to each other or one behind the other.

reporter_0.zh: 这些词均表示新闻工作者，如记者、编辑、撰稿人等。
reporter_0.en: These are all words for a person whose job is to write articles for newspapers and magazines.

oppose_0.zh: 这些词均表示反对、抵制、与⋯作斗争。
oppose_0.en: These words all mean to speak or act against things that you disagree with.

soldier_0.zh: 这些词均表示军人、士兵。
soldier_0.en: These are all words for a person who is a member of an armed force.

combine_0.zh: 这些词均表示结合、联合、合并。
combine_0.en: These words all mean to come together to form a single thing or group, or to join two or more things or groups together to form a single one.

go_1.zh: 这些词均表示行走、旅行，尤指长途旅行。
go_1.en: These words all mean to move between different places, especially over a long distance.

return_0.zh: 这些词均表示回来、回去、返回。
return_0.en: These words all mean to come or go back from one place to another.

fall_0.zh: 这些词均表示数量减少或程度下降。
fall_0.en: These are all words that can be used when the amount, level or number of sth goes down.

fall_1.zh: 这些词均表示落下，尤指突然或意外地掉落、跌落。
fall_1.en: These words all mean to move downwards, especially suddenly and/or by accident.

rain_0.en: These words are all used when water drops down from the sky.

punish_0.zh: 这些词均表示惩罚、处罚。
punish_0.en: These words all mean to make sb suffer because they have broken a rule or law or done sth wrong.

play_0.zh: 这些词均表示戏剧、剧本。
play_0.en: These are all words for a piece of writing that is intended to be performed as entertainment.

enter_0.en: These words all mean to move into a place.

inherit_0.zh: 这些词均表示继承金钱、财产、头衔或职位。
inherit_0.en: These words all mean to receive money, property, a title or position from sb when they die.

lose_0.zh: 这些词均表示在比试中落败。
lose_0.en: These words all mean to fail to win sth such as a game or contest.

turn out_0.zh: 这些词均表示未知信息为人所知、披露、公开。
turn out_0.en: These words are all used to talk about unknown information that becomes known.

win_0.zh: 这些词均表示获胜、战胜。
win_0.en: These words all mean to be successful against sb or in spite of difficulties.

occur to sb_0.zh: 这些词均表示想法或念头出现。
occur to sb_0.en: These words are all used to talk about a thought or idea coming into sb's mind.

survive_0.zh: 这些词均表示存活、幸免于难。
survive_0.en: These words all mean to remain alive.

emerge_0.zh: 这些词均表示显露、显现或突然出现。
emerge_0.en: These words all mean to begin to exist or suddenly appear.

come up with sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示想出主意、计划或方法。
come up with sth_0.en: These words all mean to think of an idea, plan or solution.

comfort_0.zh: 这两个词均表示舒适、安逸。
comfort_0.en: These are both words for the state of being relaxed and free from pain or worry.

relief_0.zh: 这些词均表示安慰、慰藉、宽慰，或令人感到安慰的人或事物。
relief_0.en: These are all words for the feeling of being less unhappy, or the person or thing that makes you less unhappy.

reassure_0.zh: 这些词均表示使安心、使消除忧虑。
reassure_0.en: These words all mean to say or do sth in order to make sb else feel better or less worried about sth.

comfortable_0.zh: 这些词均表示室内环境或某物让人感觉舒适的、舒服的。
comfortable_0.en: These words all describe an indoor place or a thing that makes you feel relaxed or warm.

magazine_0.zh: 这些词均表示杂志、期刊。
magazine_0.en: These are all words for a type of large thin book with a paper cover that is published regularly every week, every month or several times a year.

next_0.zh: 这些词均表示接着的、随后的、将来的。
next_0.en: These words all describe sth that happens, exists or is mentioned after sth else or at a time after the present.

order_0.zh: 这些词均表示指示、命令。
order_0.en: These are all words for sth that sb is told to do, especially by sb in authority.

order_1.zh: 这些词均表示命令、指挥、要求。
order_1.en: These words all mean to use your position of authority to say to sb that they must do sth.

comment_0.zh: 这些词均表示说明事实或发表意见。
comment_0.en: These words all mean to say or write a fact or opinion.

devote_0.zh: 这些词均表示将时间和精力投放在认为重要的事情上。
devote_0.en: These words all mean to give a lot of your time and effort to a particular activity or purpose because you think it is important.

reliable_0.zh: 这些词均表示人或事物可信赖的、可依靠的。
reliable_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth you can rely on to do sth, especially to give support or to work hard.

product_0.zh: 这些词均表示商品、产品。
product_0.en: These are all words for things that are produced to be sold.

general_0.zh: 这些词均表示普遍的、常见的。
general_0.en: These words all describe things that are often or almost always found, done, thought or felt.

working class_0.zh: 这些词均表示社会地位低下的、卑微的。
working class_0.en: These words all describe people from a low social class or of low status, or things connected with low social class or low status.

grass_0.zh: 这些词均表示草地、草坪、草场。
grass_0.en: These are all words for an area of ground covered with grass.

wisdom_0.zh: 这些词均表示智慧、才智。
wisdom_0.en: These are all words for a person's ability to make sensible decisions and give good advice.

republic_0.zh: 这些词均表示不同政体的国家，或政治上有联系的国家集团。
republic_0.en: These are all words for countries with different types of government, or groups of countries that are linked politically.

talk_0.zh: 这些词均表示与人谈话、商讨、交流。
talk_0.en: These words all mean to share news, information, ideas or feelings with another person or other people, especially by talking with them.

communication_0.zh: 这些词均表示人际沟通、联络。
communication_0.en: These are all words for the activity of communicating with sb.

letter_0.zh: 这些词均表示信函、邮件。
letter_0.en: These words all mean sth that you write and send to sb in order to communicate with them.

speaker_0.zh: 这些词均表示说话者或以某种方式说话的人。
speaker_0.en: These are all words for a person who talks or who is talking, especially in a particular way.

community_0.zh: 这些词均表示一个国家或地区的所有人口、国民、民众。
community_0.en: These are all words for all the people who live in a country or area.

passenger_0.zh: 这些词均表示乘客、旅客。
passenger_0.en: These are all words for a person who travels on or in a vehicle.

cramped_0.zh: 这些词均表示地方狭窄的、狭小的。
cramped_0.en: These words all describe a place that only has limited space.

small_0.zh: 这些词均表示小的、细小的。
small_0.en: These words all describe sth that is not large in size, number, degree or amount or not as large as sth else of the same type.

sympathy_0.zh: 这些词均表示同情、怜悯。
sympathy_0.en: These are all words for the feeling you have when you are sorry for sb who is unhappy or suffering.

sensitive_0.zh: 这些词均表示体贴的、有同情心的。
sensitive_0.en: These words all describe a person who shows kindness and understanding towards others.

force_1.zh: 这些词均表示迫使、强迫。
force_1.en: These words all mean to put sb in a situation where they have to do sth, especially sth that they do not want to do.

repay_0.zh: 这些词均表示偿还、赔偿、补偿。
repay_0.en: These words all mean to pay money to sb either because you owe it to them or because you have hurt them or caused them to lose or spend money.

play_2.zh: 这些词均表示参加比赛。
play_2.en: These words all mean to be involved in an activity, especially a game, race or competition.

competition_0.zh: 这些词均表示比赛、竞赛。
competition_0.en: These are all words for events in which people compete against each other to win a prize or to find out who is the best at sth.

competition_1.zh: 这些词均表示竞争、角逐、较量。
competition_1.en: These are all words for a situation in which people or organizations compete with each other for sth that not everyone can have.

smug_0.zh: 这些词均表示自鸣得意的、自满的。
smug_0.en: These words all describe sb who seems too pleased with themselves, their achievements or their behaviour.

complaint_0.zh: 这些词均表示抱怨、牢骚、抗议。
complaint_0.en: These are all words for sth which you are not happy or satisfied about and that you complain or protest about.

whole_0.zh: 这些词均表示全部的、完全的。
whole_0.en: These words all describe sth which is as big as it can or should be.

complex_0.zh: 这些词均表示复杂的、难懂的。
complex_0.en: These words all describe sth that has many parts or details and is difficult to understand.

obsession_0.zh: 这些词均表示过度的思虑、不正常的忧虑、痴迷等。
obsession_0.en: These are all words for a state of mind in which sb thinks or worries about more than is normal.

element_0.zh: 这些词均表示要素、成分、元件。
element_0.en: These are all words for sth which belongs to, but can be considered separately from, sth larger.

write_1.zh: 这些词均表示写作、作曲、编写。
write_1.en: These words all mean to produce sth in written form so that people can read, perform or use it.

structure_0.zh: 这些词均表示结构、构造、构成。
structure_0.en: These are all words for the way the different parts of sth combine together or the way that sth has been made.

work_3.zh: 这些词均表示艺术家、作家或音乐家的作品。
work_3.en: These are all words for sth that has been created by an artist, writer or musician.

compromise_0.zh: 这些词均表示折中、妥协、让步，尤指为了达成协议或解决问题。
compromise_0.en: These words all refer to a balance between the needs and wishes of two people or groups, or between two opposing things, especially in order to reach an agreement or solve a problem.

damage_1.zh: 这些词均表示伤害或损害某人或某事物。
damage_1.en: These words all mean to have a bad effect on sb/sth.

desire_0.zh: 这些词均表示想望、渴望、欲望。
desire_0.en: These are all words for a feeling, especially a strong one, that you would like to have or do sth.

regular_0.zh: 这些词均形容人经常做某事。
regular_0.en: These words all describe people who do a particular thing very often.

necessary_0.zh: 这些词均表示必须做的、必要的、强制性的。
necessary_0.en: These words all describe sth that sb has to do or have.

doubt_1.zh: 这些词均表示对所做事情正确与否的怀疑或疑问。
doubt_1.en: These are all words for a feeling that you may not be doing the right thing.

fraud_1.zh: 这些词均表示诡计、花招、骗局。
fraud_1.en: These are all words for a dishonest plan.

imagine_0.zh: 这些词均表示想象、设想。
imagine_0.en: These words all mean to form an idea in your mind of what sb/sth might be like.

issue_0.zh: 这些词均表示正在讨论的或有待处理的问题、事项。
issue_0.en: These are all words for sth that people are discussing or need to deal with.

concert_0.zh: 这些词均表示现场音乐会或演唱会。
concert_0.en: These words all mean a performance of music in front of an audience.

conclude_0.zh: 这些词均表示根据已有证据或信息认定、推断、推论。
conclude_0.en: These words all mean to decide or believe sth according to the evidence or information that you have.

conclusion_0.zh: 这些词均表示思考后得出的结论、推论。
conclusion_0.en: These are all words for sth that you decide or know is true after considering all the facts of a situation.

conclusive_0.zh: 这些词均表示确凿的、不容置疑的、毫无疑问的。
conclusive_0.en: These words all describe sth that is definitely true and allows no doubt or uncertainty.

lover_0.zh: 这些词均表示婚外的情人或性伴侣。
lover_0.en: These are all words for a sexual partner in a relationship outside marriage.

parallel_0.zh: 这些词均表示同时发生的。
parallel_0.en: These words all describe sth that happens or exists at the same time as sth else.

moisture_0.zh: 这些词均表示潮气、水汽。
moisture_0.en: These are all words for water when it is in very small drops in the air or on a surface.

summarize_0.zh: 这些词均表示总结、概括、概述。
summarize_0.en: These words all mean to repeat sth in less detail.

patronizing_0.zh: 这些词均表示有优越感的、高傲的。
patronizing_0.en: These words all describe a person whose behaviour or attitude shows that they think they are better than other people.

condition_0.zh: 这些词均表示前提条件、条款。
condition_0.en: These are all words for sth that must happen or be agreed to before an agreement can be reached or before sth else can happen.

health_0.zh: 这些词均表示人的健康状况。
health_0.en: These are all words for sb's physical state and whether they are healthy or unhealthy.

state_0.zh: 这些词均表示状态、状况。
state_0.en: These are all words for the quality or qualities that sth has at a particular time, for example whether it is good, bad, new, broken, etc.

forgive_0.zh: 这些词均表示宽恕、原谅。
forgive_0.en: These words all mean to accept sb's mistake or bad behaviour, or to stop being angry with sb who has made a mistake or behaved badly.

confine sb/sth to sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示限制、限定、约束。
confine sb/sth to sth_0.en: These words all mean to keep sb/sth within particular limits.

debate_0.zh: 这些词均表示争论、纷争、冲突。
debate_0.en: These are all words for an argument between people, groups or countries.

conservative_0.zh: 这些词均表示保守的、传统的、守旧的。
conservative_0.en: These words all describe people whose behaviour is not different from that of most other people and who may therefore be considered boring.

disprove_0.zh: 这些词均表示反驳或推翻错误观点。
disprove_0.en: These words all mean to show that sth is wrong or false.

take_7.zh: 这些词均表示将某人或某物误认为、错当成。
take_7.en: These words all mean to think that sb/sth is sb/sth else.

confused_1.zh: 这些词均表示思想、讲话或文字条理不清的、混乱的。
confused_1.en: These words all describe thought, speech or writing that does not have a clear structure.

natural_0.zh: 这些词均表示天生的、本能的、与生俱来的。
natural_0.en: These words all describe a characteristic, ability or disease that a person or animal has naturally or is born with.

full_0.zh: 这些词均表示满是⋯的、充满⋯的。
full_0.en: These words all describe sth that contains a lot of sth.

group_2.zh: 这些词均表示商业集团、合作企业。
group_2.en: These are all words for a number of people or companies working together in business.

politician_0.en: These are all words for a person whose job is concerned with politics.

guess_0.zh: 这些词均表示猜测、估计。
guess_0.en: These words all mean to form an idea of what is happening or what is true when you do not have many facts to base this on.

remind sb of sb/sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示使想起、唤起、使呈现于脑际。
remind sb of sb/sth_0.en: These words all mean to bring a feeling, memory or image into your mind.

link_0.zh: 这些词均表示相互联系。
link_0.en: These are all words that can be used when there is a connection between people or things.

link_1.zh: 这些词均表示通过物理或电子方法连接两个或多个事物。
link_1.en: These words all mean to make a physical or electronic connection between two or more things.

connection_0.zh: 这些词均表示连接点、接头、接合处。
connection_0.en: These words all mean the point or line where two things are joined together.

family_1.zh: 这些词均表示亲人、亲属。
family_1.en: These are all words for a person who is related to sb else, or a group of people who are related to each other.

conscientious_0.zh: 这些词均表示工作勤勉认真的、一丝不苟的。
conscientious_0.en: These words all describe people showing care and effort in their work or duties.

successive_0.zh: 这些词均表示连续的、无间断的。
successive_0.en: These words all describe things or people that follow one after the other without interruption.

importance_0.en: These are all words for the quality of being important and having an effect on people or things.

result_0.zh: 这些词均表示后果、结果。
result_0.en: These are all words for a thing that is caused because of sth else.

save_3.zh: 这两个词均表示节约、不浪费。
save_3.en: These words both mean to use no more of sth than necessary.

consider_0.zh: 这些词均表示考虑、思考、沉思。
consider_0.en: These words all mean to use your mind in order to try to understand sth, make a decision, solve a problem, etc.

consideration_0.zh: 这些词均表示仔细考虑、斟酌。
consideration_0.en: These are all words for the act of thinking carefully about sth.

factor_0.zh: 这些词均表示要素、因素。
factor_0.en: These are all words for sth that is important or has an effect in a situation.

texture_0.zh: 这些词均表示质地、手感。
texture_0.en: These are all words for the way a surface, substance or fabric feels when you touch it.

steady_0.zh: 这些词均表示规则的、稳定的、不变的。
steady_0.en: These words all describe things that follow a pattern and do not change.

marked_0.zh: 这些词均表示明显的、显著的。
marked_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that is easy to see or notice, especially because they are unusual or different.

secretive_0.zh: 这些词均表示人或行为诡秘的、偷偷摸摸的。
secretive_0.en: These words all describe sb or the actions or behaviour of sb who does not want to attract attention.

policeman_0.en: These are all words for a member of the police.

frequent_0.zh: 这些词均表示频繁的、经常发生的。
frequent_0.en: These words all describe things that happen or are done very often.

legal_0.zh: 这些词均表示法律允许的、法律要求的或与法律有关的。
legal_0.en: These words all describe sth that is allowed or required by law or connected with the law.

refer to sth_0.zh: 这些词均表示查阅、参考。
refer to sth_0.en: These words all mean to look at or in sth for information.

eat_0.en: These words all mean to put food or drink into your stomach through your mouth.

inspector_0.zh: 这些词均表示检查员、监管者、监督员。
inspector_0.en: These are all words for sb whose job is to check that rules are being obeyed.

impressive_0.zh: 这些词均表示技艺高超的。
impressive_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that shows a lot of skill.

recent_0.zh: 这些词均表示当前的、近来的、现今的。
recent_0.en: These words all describe sth that belongs to the present time because it is happening now or happened only a short time ago.

contempt_0.zh: 这些词均表示蔑视、鄙视或嘲笑、愚弄。
contempt_0.en: These are all words for a feeling that sb/sth does not deserve respect or comments which make fun of sb/sth.

contemptuous_0.zh: 这些词均表示蔑视的、鄙视的、嘲弄的。
contemptuous_0.en: These words all describe sb who feels or shows that sb/sth is not good enough to deserve their respect or attention.

message_0.zh: 这些词均表示文字作品、讲话或谈话的要点、主旨、大意。
message_0.en: These are all words for the main or general meaning of a piece of writing, a speech or a conversation.

satisfaction_0.zh: 这些词均表示满意、欣慰、自豪。
satisfaction_0.en: These are all words for the good feeling that you have when you are happy or when you have achieved sth.

continue_2.zh: 这些词均表示停顿后再接着做某事。
continue_2.en: These words all mean to start sth again after stopping for a time.

lead_4.zh: 这些词均表示通往、延伸至。
lead_4.en: These words all mean to cover the distance between two points or places.

shape_0.zh: 这些词均表示人或物体的体形、外形、轮廓。
shape_0.en: These are all words for the physical form or appearance of sb/sth, especially the shape of the outer edges of sb/sth.

employ_0.zh: 这些词均表示雇用、聘用。
employ_0.en: These words all mean to give sb a job to do for payment.

shrink_0.zh: 这些词均表示缩小、变短。
shrink_0.en: These words all mean to become smaller or to be narrower at one end.

deny_0.zh: 这些词均表示否认报告或声明的真实性。
deny_0.en: These words all mean to say that a report or claim is not true.

opposite_1.zh: 这些词均表示完全相反的、截然不同的。
opposite_1.en: These words all describe sth that is as different as possible from sth else.

difference_0.zh: 这些词均表示差别、不同之处。
difference_0.en: These are all words for the way in which people or things are not like each other.

different_0.zh: 这些词均表示不同的、有差异的。
different_0.en: These words all describe sb/sth that is not the same as sb/sth else.

gift_0.zh: 这些词均表示礼物，馈赠品、谢礼。
gift_0.en: These are all words for a thing that you give to sb, for example on a special occasion, to help them, or to say thank you.

involvement_0.zh: 这些词均表示参与、参加、作用。
involvement_0.en: These are all words for the fact of being active in an event or situation.

payment_0.zh: 这些词均表示应付的款项或付款。
payment_0.en: These are all words for an amount of money that you pay or are expected to pay, or for the act of paying.

control_1.zh: 这些词均表示指挥、控制、掌管。
control_1.en: These words all mean to have power over sb/sth so that you are able to decide what a person must do or how sth will work.

operate_0.zh: 这些词均表示操作、控制、操纵机器或装置。
operate_0.en: These words all mean to use a machine or device, or make it function.

disciplined_0.zh: 这些词均表示冷静的、克制的。
disciplined_0.en: These words all describe people showing calm control in the way they behave.

limited_1.zh: 这些词均表示受法律或规定限制的。
limited_1.en: These words all describe sth which is or must stay within a particular limit which has been set, often as part of a rule or law.

useful_0.zh: 这些词均表示有用的、有帮助的、适用的。
useful_0.en: These words all describe sth which helps you do sth or is suitable for a particular purpose.

tradition_0.zh: 这些词均表示传统、习俗、常规。
tradition_0.en: These are all words for behaviour that is accepted as usual by a group or society.

prisoner_0.zh: 这些词均表示囚犯、犯人。
prisoner_0.en: These are all words for a person who is kept in prison as a punishment.

convince_0.zh: 这些词均表示使确信、使信服。
convince_0.en: These words all mean to make sb believe that sth is true.

shake_2.zh: 这些词均表示颤抖、哆嗦，尤因害怕或寒冷。
shake_2.en: These words all mean to make short quick movements that you cannot control, especially because you are frightened or cold.

shiver_0.zh: 这些词均表示颤抖、痉挛、抽搐。
shiver_0.en: These are all words for a continuous or sudden shaking movement or feeling, especially one that you cannot control.

oven_0.zh: 这些词均表示炊具、炉子。
oven_0.en: These are all words for a piece of equipment for cooking or baking things.

pale_1.zh: 这些词均表示昏暗的、不鲜艳的。
pale_1.en: These words all describe light or a colour which is not bright or strong.

cope_0.zh: 这些词均表示克服困难成功应对、处理。
cope_0.en: These words all mean to deal successfully with a situation, often in spite of difficulties.

copy_0.zh: 这些词均表示手写本或印刷品的副本、誊本、复印件。
copy_0.en: These are all words for a written or printed copy of text or images.

copy_1.zh: 这些词均表示物品的复制品、仿制品、模型。
copy_1.en: These are all words for a thing that is made to look like sth else.

copy_2.zh: 这些词均表示复制、仿造、临摹。
copy_2.en: These words all mean to make sth that is exactly like sth else.

follow_3.zh: 这些词均表示模仿、效法、仿效。
follow_3.en: These words all mean to behave or do sth in the same way as sb else.

write_0.zh: 这些词均表示写字、书写。
write_0.en: These words all mean to form letters or numbers on a surface, especially using a pen or pencil.

rope_0.en: These are all words for long thin materials used for tying, fastening, sewing or holding things in place.

separate_1.zh: 这些词均表示分割、隔开、阻隔。
separate_1.en: These words all mean to split an area into more than one section, especially in order to prevent people from entering one section.

mess_1.zh: 这些词均表示困境、窘境。
mess_1.en: These are all words for a difficult situation.

take over_0.zh: 这些词均表示控制、接管、垄断。
take over_0.en: These words all mean to have or take control of sth, especially replacing sb/sth else or preventing sb/sth else from sharing it.

team_0.zh: 这些词均表示一起工作的团队、小组。
team_0.en: These are all words for a group of people working together.

correct_0.zh: 这些词均表示改正、纠正、修正。
correct_0.en: These words all mean to make sth right or accurate, or free of mistakes or problems.

mark_2.zh: 这些词均表示给学生作业打分、评分或改错。
mark_2.en: These words all mean to give a mark or grade to a student's work or to read it or listen to it and put right any mistakes.

right_1.zh: 这些词均表示恰当的、妥当的、适宜的。
right_1.en: These words all describe a belief, opinion, decision or method that is suitable or the best one for a particular situation.

true_0.zh: 这些词均表示属实的、真确的、真实的。
true_0.en: These words all describe sth that cannot be doubted as fact.

international_0.zh: 这些词均表示国际的、全球的。
international_0.en: These words all describe things that are connected with two or more countries or parts of the world.

costs_0.zh: 这些词均表示开支、支出、花费。
costs_0.en: These are all words for money spent by a government, organization or person.

price_0.zh: 这些词均表示价格、费用。
price_0.en: These are all words for the amount of money that you have to pay for sth.

valuation_0.zh: 这些词均表示对价值的评估、估价。
valuation_0.en: These are all words for a judgement that is made about how much money sth is worth or will cost.

expensive_0.en: These words all describe sth that costs a lot of money.

include_1.zh: 这些词均表示列入、计算在内。
include_1.en: These words all mean to consider sb/sth as part of a larger group.

equivalent_0.zh: 这些词均表示对应的人或事物。
equivalent_0.en: These are all words for a person or thing that is the same or similar, or that has the same function, as sb/sth else in a different place or situation.

ineffective_0.zh: 这些词均表示不起作用的、效果不佳的。
ineffective_0.en: These words all describe sth that does not achieve what is wanted or intended, or sb/sth that does not achieve very much.

country_0.zh: 这些词均表示国家、国度。
country_0.en: These are all words for an area of land that has its own government and laws.

country_1.zh: 这些词均表示乡村地区。
country_1.en: These are all words for areas away from towns and cities, with fields, woods and farms.

county_0.zh: 这些词均表示郡、县、州、省等国家行政区。
county_0.en: These are all words for an area that forms part of a country and has its own official boundaries (= borders) .

revolution_0.zh: 这些词均表示起义、造反、暴动。
revolution_0.en: These are all words for people acting together against authority.

form_1.en: These are all words for a document containing questions and spaces for answers.

direction_0.zh: 这些词均表示趋势、途径。
direction_0.en: These are all words for the general way in which sb/sth develops or sb achieves sth, over a period of time.

replacement_0.zh: 这些词均表示代替者、代替物。
replacement_0.en: These are all words for a person or thing that you use or have instead of the one you normally use or have.

security_0.zh: 这些词均表示保护、防御、掩护。
security_0.en: These are all words for a situation where sb/sth is protected by sb/sth.

the media_0.zh: 这些词均表示大众传播、新闻媒体。
the media_0.en: These are all words for sth that is used to communicate news stories and information from journalists to the public.

replace_0.zh: 这些词均表示代替、取代。
replace_0.en: These words all mean to take the place of sb/sth else in a particular role or situation.

threaten_0.zh: 这些词均表示威胁、恐吓。
threaten_0.en: These words all mean to frighten sb or say that you will hurt them in order to make them do sth.

jump_2.zh: 这些词均表示因受惊而猛地一动或后退。
jump_2.en: These words all mean to make a sudden movement or move back because you are surprised or afraid.

shy_0.zh: 这些词均表示羞怯的、腼腆的、拘谨的。
shy_0.en: These words all describe a person who is not confident or is nervous or embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people.

hug_0.zh: 这些词均表示拥抱、搂抱。
hug_0.en: These words all mean to put your arms around sb, especially to show that you like or love them.

pack_0.zh: 这些词均表示把⋯塞进或挤进窄小的空间。
pack_0.en: These words all mean to push sb/sth into a small space.

rubbish_0.zh: 这些词均表示劣质的东西。
rubbish_0.en: These are all words for sth that you think is of poor quality.

edge_1.zh: 这些词均表示徐徐移动或使某物慢慢移动。
edge_1.en: These words all mean to move or move sth slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

fashion_0.zh: 这些词均表示流行、时髦、风尚。
fashion_0.en: These are all words for particular things being very popular for a limited period of time.

mentally ill_0.zh: 这些词均表示精神失常的。
mentally ill_0.en: These words all describe sb who is suffering from a mental illness.

crazy_0.zh: 这些词均表示人疯狂的、不理智的、愚蠢的。
crazy_0.en: These words all describe sb not showing good sense or judgement.

creak_0.zh: 这些词均表示嘎吱作响、发出刮擦声。
creak_0.en: These words all mean to make a long sound like the sound made when two objects rub against each other.

fold_0.zh: 这些词均表示织物上的皱褶或人皮肤上的皱纹。
fold_0.en: These are all words for a line on fabric or on sb's skin.

crumple_0.zh: 这些词均表示压皱、弄皱、弄乱，尤指压皱织物、纸或弄乱头发。
crumple_0.en: These words all mean to make sth, especially fabric, paper or hair, no longer smooth or neat.

development_0.zh: 这些词均表示创造或创造物。
development_0.en: These are all words for the process or act of creating sth new, or for the thing created.

inspiration_0.zh: 这些词均含褒义，表示创造力、独创力、创新力。
inspiration_0.en: These are all positive words for the ability to have exciting new ideas or to create new things.

slip_0.zh: 这些词均表示悄悄地或偷偷摸摸地移动。
slip_0.en: These words all mean to move somewhere quietly, especially in order not to be noticed.

crime_0.zh: 这些词均表示犯罪活动、不法行为。
crime_0.en: These are all words for activities that involve breaking the law or breaking rules.

criminal_0.zh: 这些词均表示犯错的人、罪犯、违法者。
criminal_0.en: These are all words for a person who does sth that is wrong, dishonest or against the law.

knowledge_0.zh: 这些词均表示知识、学识。
