lose out_0.en: These words all mean to not get sth you wanted or could/should have.

loss-making_0.zh: 这些词均表示业务不赢利的、亏损的。
loss-making_0.en: These words all describe a business, organization or activity which is not making a profit.

witch_0.zh: 这些词均表示巫师、术士。
witch_0.en: These are all words for a person who is believed to have magic powers.

ruin_0.zh: 这些词均表示破坏、糟蹋、毁掉。
ruin_0.en: These words all mean to make sth unsuccessful, unpleasant, or useless when it had been good.

walk_1.zh: 这些词均表示行走、步行。
walk_1.en: These words all mean to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground.

scope_0.zh: 这些词均表示机会、可能性或时间、空间、金钱等方面的余地。
scope_0.en: These are all words for the opportunity to do sth, the possibility of sth happening, or the extra time, space, money, etc. needed for this.

marriage_0.zh: 这两个词均表示婚姻、婚礼。
marriage_0.en: These are all words for the state of being married or the occasion of getting married.

saying_0.zh: 这些词均表示谚语、格言。
saying_0.en: These are all words for a well-known statement that says sth that is generally true or gives advice.

meaning_0.zh: 这些词均表示词语或信号传递的意义、意思。
meaning_0.en: These are all words for the thing or idea that a word, phrase or sign represents.

way_1.zh: 这些词均表示方法、手段。
way_1.en: These are all words for a particular thing that you do in order to do or achieve sth.

song_0.zh: 这些词均表示歌曲、乐曲。
song_0.en: These are all words for a short piece of music.

memory_0.zh: 这些词均表示记忆力、回忆、往事。
memory_0.en: These are all words for the ability to remember things, the act of remembering or things that you remember.

resolve_0.zh: 这些词均表示消除分歧、解决问题或改善关系。
resolve_0.en: These words all mean to put an end to a disagreement, find a solution to a problem or improve a bad relationship.

miss_1.zh: 这两个词均表示未见到、未注意到。
miss_1.en: These words both mean to fail to see or notice sth.

mission_0.zh: 这些词均表示使命、重大的职责。
mission_0.en: These are all words for sth that you do, especially a job, that is important to you or that you feel is your duty.

simulate_0.zh: 这些词均表示模拟、再现。
simulate_0.en: These words all mean to create a copy of a situation or event, usually for a particular purpose.

rate_0.zh: 这些词均表示速度、进度。
rate_0.en: These are all words for a measurement of how quickly sth happens or is done.

wipe_0.zh: 这些词均表示用湿物擦、拭。
wipe_0.en: These words all mean to use sth damp to clean sth.

proposal_0.zh: 这些词均表示建议、提议。
proposal_0.en: These are all words for an idea or plan which sb suggests for sb else to consider.

silence_1.zh: 这些词均表示变得安静、使安静。
silence_1.en: These words all mean to become quieter or stop sb/sth from making so much noise.

strong_0.zh: 这些词均表示人或动物身体强壮的、健壮的。
strong_0.en: These words all describe a person or animal that has a lot of physical power.

rebel_0.zh: 这些词均表示反抗权威、造反、叛逆。
rebel_0.en: These are all words that can be used when a group of people fight against or refuse to obey those in authority.

sick_1.zh: 这些词均表示想呕吐、恶心。
sick_1.en: These words all describe people who feel as if they may vomit (= bring food from the stomach back out through the mouth) .

neat_0.zh: 这些词均表示整洁的、有序的、有条理的。
neat_0.en: These words all describe sth where everything is carefully arranged and things are in the place where they belong.

new_2.zh: 这些词均表示不熟悉的、不了解的、不习惯的。
new_2.en: These words all describe sb who is not familiar with sth because they have not experienced it before.

tip_0.zh: 这些词均表示物体的尖端、尖头。
tip_0.en: These are all words for the sharp end of an object.

sound_0.zh: 这两个词均表示声音、响声。
sound_0.en: These are both words for sth that you can hear.

sea_0.en: These are all words for the salt water that covers the earth's surface.

odour_0.zh: 这些词均表示难闻的气味、臭味。
odour_0.en: These are all words for an unpleasant smell.

office_1.zh: 这些词均表示某个人的办公室、工作室。
office_1.en: These are all words for a room in which a person works.

unattractive_0.zh: 这些词均表示不好的、无趣的、令人反感的。
unattractive_0.en: These words all describe behaviour and things that are not good, interesting or pleasant.

unofficial_0.zh: 这些词均表示非官方的、未经许可或批准的。
unofficial_0.en: These words all describe things that are not approved by sb in authority.

output_0.en: These are all words for the amount of sth that is produced.

overturn_0.zh: 这些词均表示推翻或撤销判决。
overturn_0.en: These words all mean to officially decide that a legal decision is not correct, and to make it no longer valid.

page_0.zh: 这些词均表示一页或一张纸。
page_0.en: These are all words for a single piece of paper.

patience_0.zh: 这些词均表示忍耐力、容忍。
patience_0.en: These are all words for the ability or willingness to accept sb/sth annoying or difficult without complaining.

photograph_0.en: These are all words for a picture that has been made using a camera.

place_1.zh: 这两个词均表示空座、空位。
place_1.en: These words both mean an empty space or position where sb can sit.

point_1.zh: 这两个词均表示用手指或指向。
point_1.en: These words both mean to help sb see where or what sb/sth is by stretching out your finger or hand.

poison_0.zh: 这些词均表示毒药、毒素。
poison_0.en: These are all words for substances that cause death or harm if they are swallowed or absorbed into the body.

position_0.en: These are all words for the way in which sb is standing or sitting.

potential_0.zh: 这些词均表示可能性、潜在性。
potential_0.en: These are all words for the possibility of sth happening or being developed or used successfully.

pray_0.zh: 这些词均表示祈祷、敬拜、崇拜。
pray_0.en: These words all mean to speak to God or show your respect for him.

press_1.en: These words all mean to put pressure on part of a device with your finger, hand or foot in order to make it work.

process_0.zh: 这些词均表示正常步骤或手续。
process_0.en: These are all words for ways of doing things, especially the usual or correct way.

prompt_0.zh: 这些词均表示导致、激起。
prompt_0.en: These words all mean to make sth start happening.

punishment_0.zh: 这些词均表示惩罚、刑罚。
punishment_0.en: These are all words for a way of making sb suffer because they have done sth wrong or illegal.

pure_0.zh: 这些词均表示纯的、纯净的。
pure_0.en: These words all describe sth which is not mixed with anything else.

pure_1.zh: 这些词均表示完全的、纯粹的。
pure_1.en: These words are all used to emphasize that a quality, feeling or situation is complete and not mixed with anything else.

put_1.zh: 这些词均表示使处于某种状态或情况。
put_1.en: These words all mean to cause sb/sth to be in a particular state or condition.

quiet_2.zh: 这些词均形容人寡言少语。
quiet_2.en: These words all describe people not talking very much.

ratio_0.zh: 这些词均表示比率、比例。
ratio_0.en: These are all words for the amount or size of sth compared with sth else.

reasoning_0.zh: 这些词均表示推理、理性思考或理性的观点。
reasoning_0.en: These are all words for the process of thinking about sth in a logical way, or the ideas and opinions that are based on this.

rebuild_0.zh: 这些词均表示修复、重建。
rebuild_0.en: These words all mean to repair or develop sth to make it more attractive or more useful.

relative_0.zh: 这些词均表示相对而言的、相关联的。
relative_0.en: These words all describe things that are considered according to their position or connection with sth else.

reorganize_0.zh: 这些词均表示重新组织、调整结构。
reorganize_0.en: These words all mean to change the way in which sth has been arranged or structured.

report_2.zh: 这些词均表示口头或书面的汇报、报告、记述。
report_2.en: These are all words for a spoken or written description of sth containing information that is needed by sb.

restraint_0.zh: 这些词均表示克制、自制力、约束。
restraint_0.en: These are all words for the ability to behave calmly and with control.

revenge_0.zh: 这些词均表示报复、报仇。
revenge_0.en: These are all words for sth you do against sb because of sth they have done to you.

reverse_0.zh: 这两个词均表示颠倒、撤销。
reverse_0.en: These words both mean to change sth completely so that it is the opposite of what it was before.

safety_0.zh: 这些词均表示安全、安稳、安乐。
safety_0.en: These are all words for the protection of sb/sth from harm or danger.

say_0.en: These words all mean to use your voice to express sth, especially in words.

say_2.zh: 这些词均表示假定、假设。
say_2.en: These words all mean to suggest or give sth as a possibility, or act as if sth were true even though you have no definite proof.

scatter_0.zh: 这些词均表示撒、洒、使布满。
scatter_0.en: These words all mean to make lots of small pieces of sth cover an area.

sensitive_2.zh: 这些词均表示爱生气的、易被惹恼的。
sensitive_2.en: These words all describe a person who is easily upset or offended.

set off_0.zh: 这些词均表示出发、起程。
set off_0.en: These words all mean to begin a journey.

sight_0.zh: 这些词均表示视力范围、视野。
sight_0.en: These are all words for the area or distance that you can see from a particular position.

slip_1.zh: 这两个词均表示滑倒、打滑。
slip_1.en: These words both mean to slide a short distance, usually accidentally.

slump_0.zh: 这些词均表示价值或水平骤降、猛跌。
slump_0.en: These are all words that can be used when the value or level of sth goes down suddenly.

solve_0.zh: 这些词均表示妥善解决、妥善处理。
solve_0.en: These words all mean to find a satisfactory solution to a problem or difficult situation.

sound_1.zh: 这两个词均表示音量、音响。
sound_1.en: These are both words for talking about what you can hear in terms of how loud or soft it is.

space_1.zh: 这些词均表示外层空间、太空。
space_1.en: These are all words for the area outside the earth's atmosphere.

spray_0.en: These words all mean to make sth, especially a liquid, cover sb/sth in small drops or pieces.

student_0.zh: 这些词均表示学生、小学生。
student_0.en: These are all words for a child who attends school.

study_0.zh: 这些词均表示审视、察看。
study_0.en: These words all mean to look at sb/sth carefully, especially in order to find out sth.

supplies_0.zh: 这些词均表示食物和药品之类的必需品。
supplies_0.en: These are all words for essential items such as food and medicine.

swing_0.zh: 这些词均表示摆动、摇晃。
swing_0.en: These words all mean to move backwards and forwards from a fixed point, or to make sth do this.

take_2.zh: 这些词均表示拿开、取出、挪开。
take_2.en: These words all mean to get sb/sth and move them away from a place or thing

tear_0.zh: 这些词均表示撕裂、撕碎、戳破。
tear_0.en: These words all mean to damage sth by pulling it in different directions or cutting it into pieces on sth sharp.

tense_0.zh: 这些词均表示神经紧张的、焦虑不安的、无法放松的。
tense_0.en: These words all describe people when they are too anxious to be able to relax.

the middle class_0.zh: 这两个词均表示中产阶级。
the middle class_0.en: These are both words for the social class whose members are neither very rich nor very poor and that includes business and professional people.

thing_0.zh: 这两个词均表示事实、事件、事情。
thing_0.en: These words are both used to refer in general to facts, events, situations or actions, or to what sb does, says or thinks.

transport_0.zh: 这些词均表示交通运输系统。
transport_0.en: These are all words for a system for carrying goods or people from one place to another using vehicles, roads, ships, etc.

travel_0.zh: 这些词均表示旅行、旅游。
travel_0.en: These are all words for the act or activity of going to places.

treat_1.zh: 这两个词均表示用特定方法处理、加工，尤指利用化学方法来进行。
treat_1.en: These words both mean to use a system, especially involving chemicals, to clean, protect, preserve or change sth.

trudge_0.zh: 这些词均表示因疲劳或地面难行而行走缓慢、步履艰难。
trudge_0.en: These words all mean to walk slowly with heavy steps, for example because you are tired or the ground is difficult to walk on.

try_1.zh: 这些词均表示尝试、体验。
try_1.en: These words all mean to use, do or experience sth in order to see what it is like.

turn_0.zh: 这些词均表示转身、扭转身体部位。
turn_0.en: These words all mean to move your body or part of your body in order to face another direction.

turn sth on_0.zh: 这些词均表示打开开关。
turn sth on_0.en: These words all mean to make sth such as a machine or electrical device start working.

unconscious_0.zh: 这些词均表示无意识的、下意识的。
unconscious_0.en: These words all describe sth that influences your behaviour and thoughts, even though you are not consciously aware of them.

undoubted_0.zh: 这些词均表示千真万确的、公认的、广为接受的。
undoubted_0.en: These words all describe sth that you think everybody accepts as right or true.

unwanted_0.zh: 这些词均表示不需要的、不受欢迎的、未经要求的。
unwanted_0.en: These words all describe people and things that are not wanted, invited or asked for.

view_1.zh: 这些词均表示景色、景致、景物。
view_1.en: These are all words for a thing that you can see, especially from a particular place.

wallet_0.zh: 这两个词均表示钱包、皮夹子。
wallet_0.en: These are both words for sth that you use to carry money around with you.

wave_0.zh: 这些词均表示海浪、波浪。
wave_0.en: These are all words for a raised line that moves across the surface of liquid, especially the sea.

wave_1.zh: 这些词均表示心潮涌动。
wave_1.en: These are all words for a sudden increase in sth, especially a feeling.

wise_0.zh: 这些词均表示有智慧的、明智的。
wise_0.en: These words all describe sb who is able to make good decisions or give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that they have.

wish_0.zh: 这些词均表示想要的东西、希望发生的事。
wish_0.en: These are all words for sth that sb wants to have or happen.

withdraw_0.zh: 这些词均表示撤退、撤离、撤回。
withdraw_0.en: These words all mean to move back or away from a place or situation, or to make sb/sth do this.
